description_en: Enables or disables deletion protection for a customer master key (CMK)
description_zh: 为用户主密钥（CMK）开启或关闭删除保护
name: SetDeletionProtection

parameters.help_en:
The ARN of the CMK for which you want to set deletion protection.  
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28952.html operation to query the CMK ARN (Arn)
parameters.help_zh:
待设置删除保护的CMK ARN。  
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28952.html接口查看CMK ARN（Arn）。
parameters.name: protected_resource_arn

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection. Valid values:

true: enables deletion protection.

false (default): disables deletion protection
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启删除保护，取值：

true：开启删除保护。

false（默认值）：关闭删除保护
parameters.name: enable_deletion_protection

parameters.example: The CMK is being used by XXX. Deletion protection is set.
parameters.help_en:
The description of deletion protection.  

This parameter is valid only when EnableDeletionProtection is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
删除保护描述。  

当EnableDeletionProtection取值为true时该参数有效
parameters.name: deletion_protection_description

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each API request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
